name.value: Liard Hot Springs Lodge RV Park

description.value: A year-round highway lodge and campground at Mile 497 of the Alaska Highway, directly across from Liard River Hot Springs — Canada's second-largest natural hot springs, a 15-minute walk via boardwalk through boreal forest. Basic tent sites at a commercial stop, but the hot springs make it a genuine rest-and-soak destination for northbound Alaska Highway cyclists.

address.value: Mile 497 Alaska Highway, Liard River, V0C 1R0

raw_osm.name: Liard Hot Springs Lodge RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a lodge and RV park/campground at Mile 497 on the Alaska Highway, open year-round, with 12 rooms, a full menu restaurant, and seasonal campground with serviced and non-serviced sites. Phone (250-776-7349), email (Liardlodge@hotmail.com), and address all match between OSM and the website. Food nearby is confirmed by their on-site restaurant with breakfast, lunch, and dinner menus. Reservations are confirmed via 'Please Call to Book Your Stay.' No specific hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established campground and lodge on a remote stretch of the Alaska Highway, offering tent sites, an on-site restaurant, and proximity to a major hot springs — a valuable stop for touring cyclists on the Alaska Highway corridor.
